title: The Severe winter of that year
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：severe　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 severe 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the keeper wrote of ① a severe winter of that year in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② so severe that nobody in the zoo would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the severe ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the severe winter of that year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for March 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too severe to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the severe ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a severe punishment of the school, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as severe as the punishment of the school they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was severe or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something severe, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite severe; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the severe ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, at once, she wrote of another severe winter of that year in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less severe than anybody had expected. ⑩ The severe punishment of the school that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the severe ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 严峻（前置定语 a severe winter of that year：1986 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件严峻的冬天）
B. adj. 严峻／严厉（两处加强说法：so severe that … 与 no less severe than …）
C. adj. 严峻／严厉（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 严峻（表语 too severe to do：母亲觉得它太严峻，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 严厉（前置定语 a severe punishment of the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩严厉的处罚）
F. adj. 严厉（同级比较 as severe as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校严厉的处罚相比）
G. adj. 严厉（后置定语 something severe：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 严厉（受程度副词修饰 quite severe：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a severe winter of that year
the severe winter of that year that
a severe punishment of the school
The severe punishment of the school that

answers.why: severe 意为“严峻”，1986 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件严峻的冬天”，此处作前置定语 a severe winter of that year。
severe 意为“严峻”，此处用 so severe that 结构，说它严峻到兽舍里没人敢靠近。
severe 意为“严峻”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的严峻那年严峻的冬天，等于最高级的说法。
severe 意为“严峻”，母亲认为这件东西“太严峻了，谁也用不上”，too severe to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
severe 意为“严厉”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩严厉的处罚”，此处作前置定语 a severe punishment of the school。
severe 意为“严厉”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校严厉的处罚一样严厉”，同级比较用 as severe as。
severe 意为“严厉”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“严厉的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something severe。
severe 意为“严厉”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当严厉”，quite 修饰原级 severe。
severe 意为“严厉”，no less severe than 表示“其严厉不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之严厉不亚于任何人的预料。
severe 意为“严厉”，母亲 1998 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的严厉处罚”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件严峻的冬天。（a severe winter of that year）
它严峻到兽舍里没有一个人敢靠近。（so severe that …）
母亲觉得它太严峻，谁也用不上。（too severe to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩严厉的处罚。（a severe punishment of the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校严厉的处罚一样严厉。（as severe as …）
到了 1993 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件严厉的东西。（something severe）
answers: In 1986 the keeper wrote of a severe winter of that year in the register.
It was so severe that nobody in the zoo would go near it.
My mother thought it too severe to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a severe punishment of the school.
He said nobody would call it as severe as the punishment of the school they had once had.
By 1993 the register asked for nothing but something severe.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 severe 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the keeper wrote of a severe winter of that year in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the severe winter of that year that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too severe to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a severe punishment of the school, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite severe, and everybody laughed.
The severe ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
